title: Energy and Renewable Energies — measured pilot

ownership.note: Independent government directory host link supports association; institutional identity alone remains unverified. Legacy names may differ.

conditions: Sequential Lighthouse 13.5.0 / Chrome 153 laboratory runs, up to three declared attempts per each of 3 predeclared pages on mobile and desktop; default simulated throttling and fresh browser processes. Per-pair successful-run counts and any unattempted runs are explicit; a collection stop is not a website failure. Operator network/geography unverified. Guarded DOM/axe observations use GET/HEAD and four-request concurrency; excluded requests can change rendering. No forms submitted, physical devices, field INP, full security audit, complete service process or 28-day reliability claim. Independent review pending. Different page samples are not a national comparison.
collectionNotes: 18 timing attempts recorded of 18 planned; 0 unattempted after collection limits.
3 distinct predeclared core page(s), with three attempts per page/device. Missing roles and narrower samples are not equivalent to complete website coverage.
homepage: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
contact: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
citizen-enquiry: guarded observation gaps retained; normal-browser follow-up is separate.
Recovery collection amendment: standards-aware robots parsing with original fallback response retained. Earlier guarded navigation failures remain private evidence and do not establish a site outage.
A separate normal-browser follow-up rendered all three pages; the enquiry navigation timed out before DOMContentLoaded but its captured content and controls remain explicit. No form was submitted.

Completion review 2026-10-26 of the 21 October follow-up: 6 previously unmeasured criteria resolved, adding 8 assessed budget points. 3/3 additional core-page follow-ups were representative; excluded captures and original attempts are retained. Prior valid timing samples are unchanged. 34 criteria remain unmeasured; see the completion record for required evidence.

Supplementary GET search tasks, where present, use observed search forms and do not expand the original Lighthouse timing sample. Retained visual comparison is explicitly distinguished from fresh capture. Collector connection failures, robots exclusions and incomplete responses are never website zeros.

Coverage revision 2026-10-28: 2 further criteria resolved using explicit reviewed evidence. Restricted, untested and monitoring-dependent criteria remain unmeasured. Scores and measurement coverage are different quantities; no conversion of missing evidence to passes or zeros.

findings.title: Mobile homepage loading
findings.detail: Median lab LCP 20.45 seconds, range 15.60–21.50 seconds across three successful simulated runs. This operator-network result is not a field percentile or every visitor's experience.

findings.title: Ministry contact fields are incomplete
findings.detail: The ministry address is present, but its Phone and Fax fields are empty. Affiliated-body contacts do not replace direct ministry channels.

findings.title: Citizen enquiry controls need labels
findings.detail: Associate visible labels with the required select controls and attachment input. Name the language selector and embedded frames.

findings.title: Viewport requests restricted zoom
findings.detail: The sampled viewport includes maximum-scale=1. Remove this restriction and verify actual zoom, reflow and assistive-technology behavior; those complete checks remain unmeasured.

categories.label: External Security Posture and Technical Privacy

rows.label: HTTPS enforced
rows.reason: The declared HTTP entry upgraded to trusted HTTPS without an observed downgrade. Credit is limited to this captured entry chain.

rows.label: Valid TLS certificate
rows.reason: Hostname/date/chain-verified HTTPS succeeded with the separately root-verified public intermediates supplied to the recovery Node process. Default Node chain construction failed on some hosts; this is not evidence of complete server-delivered chains or universal client compatibility. See the recovery amendment.

rows.label: Modern TLS configuration
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Full protocol/cipher assessment, not one negotiated connection. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: HSTS present and meaningful
rows.reason: Captured HSTS policies were parsed against the frozen rule: full requires max-age at least one year with includeSubDomains; a valid positive narrower policy earns half; absent, disabled or malformed earns zero. Worst declared page governs.

rows.label: Content-Security-Policy present and meaningful
rows.reason: The captured homepage header only declares frame-ancestors 'self', and the same-capture meta inventory has no additional CSP. Framing protection alone does not restrict script/object sources under the frozen meaningful-policy rule.

rows.label: Other important security headers
rows.reason: Reviewed nosniff, DENY/SAMEORIGIN or restrictive frame-ancestors, and explicit meaningful Referrer-Policy values. Full needs all three protections, half some, zero none; worst sampled page governs.

rows.label: Secure cookie configuration
rows.reason: Only attributes of observed cookies are reviewed. Full requires Secure, HttpOnly and explicit Lax/Strict on all; partial means mixed protections. No names/values or complete consent/tracking audit are published.

rows.label: No mixed HTTP/HTTPS content
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Browser and sampled-page evidence. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: No unnecessary software/version exposure
rows.reason: Reviewed the captured response Server/X-Powered-By fields and generator metadata on all three representative core documents. No software product/version disclosure was established in this specific header/metadata sample. Full criterion credit is sample-bounded and does not assert a modern, patched or vulnerability-free stack.

rows.label: No obvious sensitive configuration exposure
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Passive eligible-page review only; no guessed sensitive paths. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Third-party tracking and technical privacy restraint
rows.reason: Insufficient verified evidence for the complete criterion: Request inventory plus tracking classification. Untested steps and constrained observations remain unmeasured, not passed or failed.

rows.label: Largest Contentful Paint
rows.reason: Worst page/device median lab LCP 20446 ms; full/half limits 2500/4000 ms. Not field p75.

rows.label: Responsiveness
rows.reason: Worst median lab TBT 9 ms; full/half limits 200/600 ms. Explicit lab proxy, not field INP.

rows.label: Cumulative Layout Shift
rows.reason: Worst median lab CLS 0.0257; full/half limits 0.1/0.25. Sampled navigation only.

rows.label: Server response and first content
rows.reason: Worst median FCP 4499 ms and document response audit 615 ms. Full 1800/800; half 3000/1800. Response excludes connection/redirect time.

rows.label: Resource and page-weight efficiency
rows.reason: Worst median transfer 8345064 bytes, 253 requests. Full decimal 2MB/80; half 4MB/150.

rows.label: Performance consistency
rows.reason: Largest repeated within-page/device max/min LCP ratio 2.14; full/half 1.5/2. Operator network sample only.

rows.label: Verified WCAG 2.2 issue set
rows.reason: The reviewed normal-browser sample confirms an unnamed language select and iframes without title or accessible-name attributes. These programmatic-name defects are corroborated by the corresponding axe checks. This is a verified sampled issue set, not a comprehensive WCAG certification.

rows.label: Color contrast
rows.reason: The retained mobile screenshots show small white date/social/navigation labels on green. The captured #ffffff on #189f52 style at 12px regular is about 3.43:1, below 4.5:1. Partial credit for a localized repeated header-label defect; body-text conformity was not inferred from the absence of tool findings.

rows.label: Image alternative text
rows.reason: The sampled citizen-enquiry form displays the loaded first-party /captcha/default image without an alt attribute. The DOM records a visible 120 by 36 px challenge image and axe confirms the missing alternative. Partial credit records the missing challenge-purpose alternative; no claim is made about successful CAPTCHA completion or a submitted enquiry.

rows.label: Form labels, instructions and errors
rows.reason: The enquiry form has unlabelled required select controls (state, municipality, customers, energies and pattern): the captured controls have no associated label or aria-label. Normal-browser axe confirms select-name failures and the unlabelled file attachment. This concrete label defect prevents issue-set credit; validation/errors and form delivery were not exercised.

rows.label: Forms usable on mobile
rows.reason: Manually reviewed the fresh 28 October full-page screenshots at 320/390/844 CSS px with the field geometry/type records. The form fields fit, but name/address/phone/email prompts rely on placeholders and both phone and email use generic text inputs. The screenshot and DOM corroborate the loss of persistent field guidance and lack of mobile input-type assistance. Partial credit records initial-form usability friction; CAPTCHA and submission remain untested. Credit is limited to the sampled pre-submission mobile interface. No data was entered, file uploaded, CAPTCHA solved, form submitted, physical keyboard certified, error recovery tested or service completed. A separate fresh DOM check confirms that these generic phone/email text inputs also have no inputmode override.

Current blocked or incomplete follow-ups do not replace the retained rendered evidence.
